## About
B & E Auto Service is a family-owned repair shop on Lawrenceville Hwy in Tucker. We handle everything from routine maintenance to major repairs on foreign and domestic cars, and we serve neighbors from Tucker, Decatur, Lilburn, Snellville, Clarkston, Stone Mountain and nearby.
Our technicians attend training sessions through the year and work with current diagnostic equipment. As a Delco Professional Service Center, we get the backing of a national network while staying the same family shop you can talk to face to face.
Your car is a big investment, so we treat it like it's our own. One customer told us we remounted her Subaru engine for a fraction of what the dealership quoted. We'd like to earn your trust the same way.

## Services
- Routine maintenance and tire services: Regular upkeep, everyday repairs and tire work to keep your car running mile after mile.
- Major and minor repairs: Repairs big and small on both foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Engine diagnostics and performance: Not sure what's wrong? Bring it in and our technicians will track down the problem.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule a service?
A: Call us or send a request through our online form. A request doesn't lock in a time, but we'll get back to you within 24 hours to set one up that works for you.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Tucker and work on cars for people from Decatur, Lilburn, Snellville, Clarkston, Stone Mountain and the surrounding areas.
